data.name: Spirit Animal
data.description: The flesh of the spirit animal accurately reflects the stars that would be visible in the night sky, no matter where the animal is or the time of day.  Due to this, it can be used as a star map.  While the animal is flying, a small nimbus of light surrounds it.
